name: Spanish
bridgesBlurb: One rule, many words. Read the trick, then build each word yourself before you reveal it.
phoneticsSubtitle: An English-style respelling under the Spanish sentence — CAPS is the stressed syllable.

reminders.title: 🌮 Your Spanish tiene hambre
reminders.body: Feed it a few frases — two minutes, that's all. ¡Qué rico! 😋

reminders.title: 🔥 ¡No te olvides!
reminders.body: Your streak is still alive… but only just. ¿Unas frases hoy? 💪

reminders.title: ☕ Un cafecito y un poco de español
reminders.body: Best combo there is. Five sentences, ¡y listo! 😎

reminders.title: 💃 ¡Ándale!
reminders.body: Two minutes of practice, then you can dance. ¿Estás listo? ¿Estás lista? 🎶

reminders.title: 🌯 Tacos first? No, no, no.
reminders.body: Earn them — unas frases te esperan. Then you can feast. 🥑

reminders.title: 😴 ¿Mañana? No, hoy.
reminders.body: Mañana means tomorrow, and also never. Five sentences today. ⏰

reminders.title: 🐢 Poco a poco
reminders.body: Little by little — se va lejos. A few frases and you're done. 🧱

reminders.title: 🎸 ¡Qué padre!
reminders.body: A little Spanish sounds good on you. ¡Sigue así! 🎵

reminders.title: 🌶️ Ponle sabor
reminders.body: Add some spice to your day: five sentences, bien picantes. 🔥

reminders.title: 🦜 ¿Qué onda?
reminders.body: That's your Spanish parrot checking in. ¡Hagámoslo juntos! ✨

reminders.title: 🧠 Botanita para el cerebro
reminders.body: A little snack for your brain. Unas frases y ya. 🍿
